description: ANP open data catalogue is a data repository run by Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP), found in the Americas country search of 2026-09-30. Petroleum production, natural gas, biofuels, infrastructure, prices, imports and exports and operational incidents, in more than 50 datasets with an inventory document. Coverage: Brasil. The homepage answered on 2026-09-30; its title reads "Dados abertos — Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis". Text above taken from the homepage (page summary); the data pages behind it were not opened. It is reached through the link recorded on this page. Access to the repository is free of charge and open; individual data sets may carry their own conditions. The licence is set per dataset in the repository (not stated on the homepage). Caveats: only the homepage was read, so the data sets behind it, their formats, their licences and their current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of Brasil.
